description: This file defines the HomeScreen widget for a Flutter application, including UI components for dashboard elements such as header, hero card, quick actions, KPI stats, chart placeholder, and recommended courses. It also manages initialization via providers and navigation actions.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: Main widget class representing the home screen/dashboard page.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the state and build logic for HomeScreen.

classes.name: _HeroIntroCard
classes.description: A stateless widget displaying an introductory hero card with gradient background and an icon.

classes.name: _QuickActionsGrid
classes.description: A stateless widget displaying a grid of quick action tiles with icons and labels.

classes.name: _KpiRow
classes.description: A stateless widget showing a row of KPI cards with icons and metrics.

classes.name: _ChartPlaceholder
classes.description: A widget showing a placeholder for a chart with a header, subtitle, and bars.

classes.name: _MockBadge
classes.description: A widget indicating whether mock mode is active, with icon and label.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the HomeScreen widget.
